EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi Team,
Good news - the quote - {!Quote.Name} has been reviewed and officially approved!
{!Quote.Link}
Thanks to everyone who provided input. We can now proceed with the next steps as planned.
Please make sure all relevant teams are looped in, and let me know if any additional documentation or actions are needed on my end to keep things moving.
Appreciate the collaboration as always - let’s get this show on the road!
